thread:
sai (ux): Dropping a tiny prototype for a compact latency view. Goals: fold heatmap into a sparkline at narrow widths, add a micro p95 comparator, and introduce a sampling simulator that shows "detection power" and est p95 bias. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/compact-visuals-v1.png :eyes:

hana (product): Love the compact approach. Two asks: keep the Last 1h/24h/7d presets, and make baseline pinning obvious (pin icon + tooltip). Default sampling = 100% for new orgs to avoid surprise cost hits.

evan (eng): Default 100% makes sense. Implementation notes: when folding to sparkline request coarser tiles server-side to avoid bandwidth spikes. Also debounce scrubber drags (150ms) and only fire immediate fetches on snap or mouseup. Example: ```js
let t;
sc.on('drag', e => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(()=>fetch(e.time),150); });
sc.on('snap mouseup', e => fetch(e.time));
```

sai (ux): Will wire that in. UX: the simulated results show rows: sample %, est p95, detection power, est cost delta. Auto-suggest button offers a recommended % based on traffic and cost target.

leila (research): Detection power is useful but we should surface how it's computed. Suggest a tooltip: "Detection power = probability of detecting an event of X magnitude given current sampling and traffic." Also show a small confidence indicator for the est p95 (e.g., CI band).

aria (a11y): Accessibility notes: presets are buttons and need aria-pressed. Heatmap/sparkline cells need keyboard focus and aria-labels like "14:05 - 14:10: p95 312ms, 120 reqs". Color-only intensity fails WCAG; add a pattern overlay option and a numeric tooltip. Simulate modal must provide plain-text results for screen readers and announce progress updates.

hana (product): Copy nit: change panel title to "Latency visuals" and label the slider "Sampling for visuals". Tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may underrepresent rare spikes." Keep auto-suggest off by default for new orgs.

evan (eng): Auto-suggest needs org-level caps: min 1% unless the org opts in to 0.5%. We'll gate behind a feature flag and add telemetry: simulate_run, sampling_accepted, baseline_pinned. Also cache simulation results per-org for 12h to limit compute.

sai (ux): Good. On small screens the comparator becomes a single stat: "p95 now: 420ms (+68ms vs baseline)" with a chevron to expand details. I'll increase hit targets to 44px and add a focus ring for snaplines.

leila (research): For the simulate modal, include a tiny histogram icon next to each row and a CSV export. If simulation is expensive, show a cached result with a "re-run" button and an ETA.

aria (a11y): Keyboard: arrow keys to move between sparkline buckets, Enter to snap, Home/End to jump. Modal must trap focus. Announce results like: "Estimated p95 at 10% sampling: 428ms. Detection power: 42 percent."

evan (eng): Backend: compute percentile CI so UI can render the faint band; for sparkline folding return aggregated buckets and a granularity hint (e.g., "granularity: 1m") so users know sampling assumptions. Also add query param serialization {range, baselinePinned, sampling} for shareable URLs.

hana (product): UX copy: add a low-sample pill when sampling <20%: "Low sampling may miss rare latency spikes" with a learn-more link to docs and a quick simulation CTA.

sai (ux): I'll update the prototype with: pinned baseline UX, CI band, detection-power micro-stat, low-sample pill, pattern overlay toggle, and annotated a11y hints. Will post updated link and a 30s walkthrough clip in ~2h. :sparkles:

uibot: Tasks created: UX updates, backend simulate caching, heatmap a11y audit, telemetry. Feature flags: sparkline-fold=false, sampling-auto-suggest=false.

evan (eng): I'll land the debounce + snap handling in the runtime-ui branch and add the simulate cache. Will include feature flag and telemetry hooks.

hana (product): Thanks all  please drop PRs and the updated prototype link here when ready. :thumbsup:

sai (ux): Closing loop  will follow up with annotated mocks. (reacts :raised_hands:)
